headline: Maui County Council Public Hearing

meeting.voteItem: Close public testimony at the beginning of the public hearing
meeting.summary: The Council heard testimony on Bills 163 CD1 and 164 CD1, including concerns about water and an unfinished environmental impact statement.
meeting.recap: The Council held a public hearing on Bills 163 CD1 and 164 CD1.[[0:00:29]] The first testifier asked where the water for the development would come from.[[0:05:10]] A council member told a second testifier the bills were not about the overnight parking proposal she read about.[[0:14:12]] A caller said the Clerk's Office did a poor job telling the public what this hearing was about.[[0:15:39]] Another testifier said changing the zoning would be great.[[0:20:50]] Bill 163 CD1 would add a 163.443-acre portion of a parcel to the Maui Island Plan's urban growth boundary (the area planned for growth).[[0:24:09]] A testifier said acting now is premature because the final environmental impact statement (EIS, a study of a project's effects) is not done.[[0:25:22]] He said the site is very close to the end of the runway.[[0:25:43]] He said the water supply is not certain because the project would use one well that is not yet properly tested.[[0:27:54]] Bill 164 CD1 would change the community plan designation for a 163.443-acre portion of a parcel from Agriculture to Business Multifamily.[[0:32:14]] The public hearing was adjourned.[[0:33:24]]
decided: The Council closed opening public testimony and accepted written testimony with no objections.
The Council closed public testimony on Bill 163 CD1 and accepted written testimony with no objections.
The Council closed public testimony on Bill 164 CD1 and accepted written testimony with no objections.

moments.q: Council member clears up confusion about which project the bills cover
Kula caller testifies against both bills
"I believe your action right now is premature."

trackerIssues.title: Bills 163 and 164 for 163-acre Central Maui growth

issues.oneLine: Testifiers asked where the water for the proposed development would come from.
issues.why: A testifier said there would be no backup water supply if the project's single well stopped working.
issues.brief: A testifier said the project would use one well that is not yet properly tested.[[#1]] The first testifier asked council members to look closely at water use and land use.[[#2]]

issues.oneLine: Bill 164 CD1 would change a 163.443-acre portion of a parcel from Agriculture to Business Multifamily in the Wailuku-Kahului Community Plan.
issues.why: A testifier said he wants the housing built but that it could be done elsewhere with less impact.
issues.brief: A caller said he would support the project if it were for people under 30% of the AMI (area median income).[[#1]] A testifier said he hoped a school would be built to serve the 700 to 800 children in the new community.[[#2]] A testifier said other land already approved for building is available near the old Dunes restaurant and the Maui Lani project.[[#3]]
